LightningComponentBundle.description: Persistent global header (brand identity, primary navigation, and eyebrow utilities) for the Sinclair Brand Portal chrome. Rendered once into the site theme layout header region so it appears identically on every page.

property.name: logoAssetUrl
property.label: Logo Asset URL
property.description: ContentAsset URL for the Sinclair logo. Leave empty to render the SINCLAIR / Brand Portal text lockup.

property.name: searchRouteName
property.label: Search Route Name
property.description: Named LWR route for the portal search entry point (results are a separate story).

property.name: profileRouteName
property.label: Profile Route Name
property.description: Named LWR route for the account/profile entry point.

property.name: cartRouteName
property.label: Cart Route Name
property.description: Named LWR route for the cart entry point (cart backing is out of scope).

property.name: navigationLinkSetDeveloperName
property.label: Navigation Menu Developer Name
property.description: Developer name of the NavigationLinkSet rendered by the embedded navigation.
